title: Cold/secondary-electron transport is incomplete
finding: No elastic event kernel below1keV, no rotation/vibrational event channels, one selected electronic state only. Scalar/momentum/energy-loss observables are available but are not exclusive differential events.
remediation: Bind supported low-energy angle/internal-state kernels and consistent state/reference inventories, or quantify declared omitted-process bounds. Do not use momentum-transfer/effective/stopping cross sections as extra event rates.

title: Attachment and fragment-ion channels are not complete
finding: Hminus is applied only6.25..6.75eV although its source yield is positive at8.5/12eV; Ominus is never an event. remediation: Add source-qualified event multiplicities, all neutral/electron products and state/angle/internal closures. Treat yield curves as observables until that contract exists; do not synthesize branches by arbitrary yield normalization.

title: Native multichannel and OHv family admission are absent
finding: Generic native proofs use one fixed outcome-specific registry under forced_kernel_integration_only. Current single-channel completion requires every SSA child to match one channel/model; Hminus needs five allowed product alternatives under one base rate. Latest full-time candidate remains single-channel and unqualified.
remediation: Introduce a separately versioned immutable channel-set/product-family schema, preserve old single-channel checks, bind every child data/kernel/model/clock/stage/prefix, and qualify commit/replay/rollback. Do not relabel forced tests or duplicate full rates.

title: Spatially separated capture cannot be admitted
finding: DEA rates remain in the race, but sample requires exact3D coincidence. Native also refuses net charge transfer between distinct reactant sites. Independent macro e/H2O pairs normally need not coincide; selected capture will abort, not provide a complete reacting history.
remediation: Specify/qualify a physical collision-site and compatible reaction-current/work path before nonlocal capture. Retain the refusal meanwhile. Do not drop positive capture pairs, skip selected events, or move ions to the electron site merely to pass.

title: Conservation does not validate the EEDF/angles
finding: Parent/outer3 prescribe equal-energy back-to-back CM electron pairs; A1B1 uses fixed7.49eV loss and ground/isotropic breakup; DEA factorizes a narrow6.5eV fit; OHminus uses ground/isotropic endpoint; IAM is an incoherent O+2H free-atom approximation.

title: Physical first moments do not establish stochastic convergence
finding: With k=sigma*g/V, cohort hazard=max(Wp,Wn)k and event weight=min(Wp,Wn) preserve WpWn*k. Frozen-population count variance scales as WpWn*min(Wp,Wn)k, so weights/decomposition alter correlations and noise even at fixed mean physical source.
remediation: Converge macro weights/target carrier representation, cell size and interval with fixed physical source/neutral inventory. Report density, free-electron EEDF, species charge/current, ionization/attachment counts and variance; do not claim physical breakdown-delay fluctuations from first-moment tests.

title: Coverage evidence cap is below a broad kinetic population
finding: Default256 distinct relative energies refuses257; hard maximum1024 admits1024 and refuses1025. The old pre-kick fixture has46726 distinct stationary-H2O relative energies. This is an honest bounded refusal, not a physical zero or current physics-rate bug.
remediation: Fork a bounded streaming/hash/weighted-coverage evidence path that retains every supported/positive/unknown contribution, without changing rates or omitting pairs; qualify resource equivalence. Do not simply suppress the cap.

title: RGA does not fix local H2O density/composition
finding: The current recovered50-channel figure is published vector geometry, not raw calibrated neutral partial pressures. At assumed5e-5Torr and300K ideal-gas total density is1.6094166e12cm^-3; water is x_H2O times that unknown fraction. Desorbed oxide-water inventory/ground-state effusion is a declared surrogate scenario, not measured SS304 coverage.
remediation: Bind p,T,x species and sensitivity as explicit background scenarios or recover calibration/cracking matrix; use finite transported desorption inventory and gas internal-state assumptions. Keep microscopic source/binding/translation energy debits distinct and avoid normalizing RGA peaks into neutral fractions.

title: Cell volume, density and field resolution remain host-owned
finding: Rates use m2,m/s,m3 once. Generic fixtures use authored1e-12m3, not a verified full foil collision grid. Input positions/cell volume/native epoch are not authenticated by the sampler. Height-averaged field charge and a midplane diagnostic slab are not alternate gas populations.
remediation: Bind actual physical3D vacuum cell volumes and native private census/phase; keep all species number densities cm^-3, net charge separately, and converge collision-cell/Debye/plasma/gyro/coupling scales. Do not substitute slab volume or apply height twice.
